device.name: Isaac Lab Extreme Parkour teacher task (Unitree Go2)

facts.text: The teacher task is registered as gym id Isaac-Extreme-Parkour-Teacher-Unitree-Go2-v0 with entry_point parkour_isaaclab.envs:ParkourManagerBasedRLEnv and the UnitreeGo2TeacherParkourEnvCfg configuration
ParkourManagerBasedRLEnv is a vectorized Gymnasium environment: it sets is_vector_env = True
The teacher scene configures 6144 environments with an environment spacing of 1.0
The teacher config sets decimation 4, an episode length of 20.0 s, a simulation timestep of 0.005 s and a render interval equal to the decimation
The shared ActionsCfg drives every robot joint (joint_names ['.*']) with scale 0.25 and the default joint offset, action_delay_steps [1, 1], an action history of 8 and a per-joint clip of (-4.8, 4.8)
The teacher configuration overrides joint_pos.use_delay to False and joint_pos.history_length to 1
The action term applies processed_actions as joint position targets
The action term clips raw actions then computes processed_actions as raw_actions * scale + offset
The policy configuration counts 53 proprioceptive values, 132 height scans, 9 privileged explicit values, 29 privileged latent values (4 + 1 + 12 + 12) and a history of 10

ExtremeParkourObservations concatenates the 53-value proprioceptive vector, the 132 measured heights, the 9 privileged explicit values, the 29 privileged latent values and the flattened history buffer

The single action space is a Box(low=-inf, high=inf, shape=(action_dim,)) where action_dim is the sum of the action term dimensions; the environment then batches the observation and action spaces over num_envs
The single observation space is a Dict of Box(low=-inf, high=inf) spaces shaped by the observation manager groups, batched over num_envs

step processes the action, applies it over the configured decimation physics steps, computes terminations, rewards and resets, and returns (obs_buf, reward_buf, reset_terminated, reset_time_outs, extras)
The terminate_episode function ORs roll/pitch cutoffs above 1.5 rad, a base-height cutoff below -0.25 m, episode-length exhaustion and goal-count exhaustion into reset_buf
TerminationsCfg declares terminate_episode as a time_out=True term
The reset signature takes seed, env_ids and options and returns (observations, extras)
The demo launches the Omniverse application with AppLauncher and later constructs ParkourManagerBasedRLEnv(cfg=env_cfg)
The README installs the package inside an external IsaacLab checkout with pip3 install -e .
The repository LICENSE names GNU General Public License version 3
The environment module carries an Isaac Lab Project Developers copyright and a BSD-3-Clause SPDX header

determinism.notes: reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 fixes the seed of the next reset. The fake's only randomness is Python's random.Random for the placeholder initial state, so the fake is reproducible for a seed; the upstream simulator's determinism (PhysX, the event manager and 6144 environments) was not run or established here.

fidelity.engine: analytic:single-environment parkour contract fake (no Isaac Sim/PhysX)
gaps: the fake is a hand-written stand-in, not a recording and not the Isaac Sim environment: its dynamics, observation values, reward, contacts, terrain and sensors are placeholders; the Box/Dict structure, nominal 20 ms control period and episode-length cutoff are derived from the clone; dimensions are single-environment placeholders and none of the roll, pitch, height or goal predicates is modelled

the upstream environment is vectorized (is_vector_env = True, 6144 environments in the teacher config); the SDK Gymnasium bridge drives one environment, so the fake presents a single-environment view and keeps batched space shapes for num_envs = 1 but returns scalar rewards and flags. It omits the upstream tensor/vector returns and automatic per-environment reset; this is a fake-only contract

the action dimension 12 is a placeholder: the action term drives every joint of the Unitree Go2 and the clone does not state the joint count; 12 is inferred from the 12 joint stiffness and 12 joint damping terms counted in parkour_rl_cfg.py:25 and is not a sourced dimension of the action space

the upstream Gym action space is unbounded, but this package rejects raw actions outside the (-4.8, 4.8) clip interval before stepping: its fake Box is deliberately narrower and its derived bounds identify the fake backend, not the upstream Gym space. The clip values are separately cited at parkour_mdp_cfg.py:349. The fake uses absolute scale-0.25 position targets with placeholder zero default offsets and instantaneous tracking, not incremental motion; the teacher disables delay and uses a history of one

the observation is a placeholder vector of 753 values: 53 + 132 + 9 + 29 + 10 * 53, from the policy configuration (parkour_rl_cfg.py:24-28) and the concatenation in observations.py:85-90; the values are not the simulator's observations
no rendering, cameras, ray-cast height scanner, contact sensor, terrain generation, physics integration or manager computation is modelled

only the fake backend is declared. The implicit gymnasium.make route is not a working live adapter: the native constructor requires cfg (parkour_manager_based_rl_env.py:30-32), its step expects a torch tensor (95-97) and returns vector rewards/flags (165), while this package supplies no cfg, device tensor conversion or scalar/vector adapter. Isaac Sim, a GPU, external assets and task registration are also required; the route was not run

native construction creates a global SimulationContext, scene and managers, starts or reuses the timeline and prints to stdout (parkour_manager_based_env.py:40-141); reset may wait for asset loading without a timeout (180-182). No timeline pause/read-back or process isolation is provided
the repository LICENSE is GPL-3.0, while the cited environment modules retain BSD-3-Clause Isaac Lab headers; no upstream code or assets are copied into this package
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: On the declared fake backend, the latch refuses step and reset until mhs.safety.reset clears it, and the cached state stays readable. No native Isaac Sim pause or stop is provided; this latch does not establish that an independently running Isaac timeline has stopped.
